title: Distribution of Serpens South protostars revealed with ALMA
question: Are the protostars in the young Serpens South cluster mass segregated, and is any segregation primordial rather than dynamical?

what.value: YSO catalog with SED classes used to classify sources

evidence.quote: We use especially the catalog of (cite: Dun15) for classifying sources in this work.
$436.0\pm9.2$ pc, which we adopt for Serpens South in our study.

evidence.loc: 2.2 Supplementary data to study dense gas
evidence.quote: the data were presented in (cite: Fer14)

recipe.method: tclean with MFS on line-free channels, combining arrays, primary-beam corrected

recipe.goal: Identify mm sources and measure fluxes
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fits to peaks above local 5 sigma, two-Gaussian fits for two blended pairs
key_parameters: 5 sigma threshold varying with local rms

recipe.method: Optically thin dust emission, M = D^2 S/(B(Td) kappa)
key_parameters: Td = 35 K with IR counterpart, 15 K without

recipe.goal: Test stability of sources without IR counterpart
recipe.method: Compare observed density and radius with Bonnor-Ebert critical density and maximum radius
key_parameters: T = 15 K, mu = 2.73 mH, M_BE = mm mass

recipe.method: MST length of N most massive sources vs mean over 500 random sets, giving Lambda_MSR
assumptions: Analysis limited to sources without IR counterpart, presumed roughly coeval

recipe.method: Spitzer 1969 segregation time with crossing time from N2H+ velocity dispersion
key_parameters: v_disp=0.47 km/s, R_hm=0.14 pc, <m>=0.4 Msun, N~100

evidence.quote: We identified 52 mm sources in our map
The masses we measured are in the range of 0.002 to 0.9 $\mbox{M$_\odot$}$
an approximately flat plateau with a mean value of $\langle\Lambda_{MSR}\rangle \sim3.7$ for $3\leq N_{MST}\leq18$
a very large value of the mass segregation ratio for $N_{MST}=2$ ($\Lambda_{MSR}\sim43$
The resulting crossing time is $t_{crossing}=0.6$ Myr.

answer_key.quantity: Median distance of sources from cluster center

evidence.quote: we measure a median distance from the cluster center of 0.06 pc
This corresponds to 70% of the sample of mm sources with no IR counterpart

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version and calibration (pipeline vs manual) details
Clean threshold, cell size, image size, and number of iterations
Exact cluster center coordinates and the N2H+ weighting
Mass formula treatment of unresolved sources
Random seed for the 500 MST random sets
Whether total or peak flux was used for mass
score_reason: Data public and recipe mostly described with a source table, but many processing details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple recipe, and numeric results (52 sources, masses, Lambda_MSR).
